title: A Clash of Kings
author: George R. R. Martin
summary: With the realm splitting under rival claimants, five kings fight for the crown while a boy-king's mother schemes in the capital. The Starks are scattered and an exiled queen tries to raise power in the east.
readIf: you finished the first book and want its war-and-intrigue story to widen across more characters.
skipIf: you haven't read the first book, as it picks up without any recap.

pairings.reason: The first book, if you want to start the series from the beginning.
A gritty fantasy of war told from the soldiers' side, for readers who like that same disillusioned tone.
A single-volume epic of politics, loss and revenge with a more lyrical voice.
